scripture.title: Biblia Wujka (1923)
scripture.credit: Jakub Wujek, 1923 Warsaw edition. Verse transcription from BibliePolskie.pl via Targum. Verse text only. Public domain.
scripture.approval: The 1923 title page identifies its source as the 1599 Kraków edition, approved by the Apostolic See and the archbishop. No separate imprimatur has been verified for the 1923 printing.

scripture.title: Bible Crampon (1923)
scripture.credit: Augustin Crampon, 1923 edition. CrossWire FreCrampon (Wikisource transcription), public domain. Verse text only; Acts 14 verse divisions restored.
scripture.approval: Imprimatur printed for the Crampon edition: V. Cantineau, Vicar General, Tournai, September 1, 1930.

scripture.title: Bibbia Martini
scripture.credit: Antonio Martini. Structured transcription curated by Giovanni Novelli (Parola Viva), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Converted to chapter and verse arrays with normalized whitespace. John 11, 1 Thessalonians 4, and 1 Peter 5 use the historical text from https://www.scrutatio.it/bibbia/lettura/it/martini.
scripture.approval: Antonio Martini’s translation received the approval of Pope Pius VI.

scripture.title: Vulgata Clementina (1914)
scripture.credit: Clementine Vulgate, 1914 Michael Hetzenauer edition. Verse transcription from SacredBible.org. Public domain.
scripture.approval: The 1914 Hetzenauer printing includes an imprimatur on page 1281.
